## 🎨 Palette's Accessibility & UX Checklist
<!-- Mark the items that apply to your changes -->

### Accessibility (a11y)
- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Used appropriate elements (`<button>`, `<label>`, `<nav>`, etc.)
- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: Added descriptive `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` to icon-only buttons or complex components
- [ ] **Color Contrast**: Verified that text and UI elements meet WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratios
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: Ensured all interactive elements are focusable and have visible focus indicators
- [ ] **Screen Reader Support**: Used `lang` attributes for localized content and verified reading order
- [ ] **Alt Text**: Provided descriptive alternative text for informative images

### User Experience (UX)
- [ ] **Loading States**: Added visual feedback for asynchronous operations
- [ ] **Form Validation**: Provided clear, actionable error messages and success feedback
- [ ] **Hover/Active States**: Added visual cues for mouse/touch interactions
- [ ] **Consistency**: Followed existing design patterns and spacing guidelines
- [ ] **Mobile Responsive**: Verified layout and interactions on smaller screen sizes
